```{r build-table, include=FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# Every range and source string is DERIVED from the analysis configuration
# (issue #153):
#   - cost, utility and prevalence ranges: the one-way DSA bounds actually run
#     by 09_DSA.R (build_dsa_ranges(), +/- DSA_mult, capped to the support);
#   - discount-rate and time-horizon ranges: the deterministic structural
#     scenarios run by 09_DSA.R (dsa_structural_scenarios());
#   - utility source: UTILITY_SOURCE switch (02_setup_and_global_variables.R);
#   - prevalence CIs: exact binomial in the shared complete-case economic population.
# =============================================================================

parameter_config <- configure_parameter_distributions(l_params_base)
dsa_ranges <- build_dsa_ranges(l_params_base, parameter_config$spec,
                               mult = DSA_mult)
scenarios <- dsa_structural_scenarios(
  base_dr = dr,
  base_horizon_years = time_horizon / 52,
  base_pp_cost = l_params_base$c_other_pp
)

dsa_range <- function(par, fmt) {
  row <- dsa_ranges[dsa_ranges$pars == par, ]
  if (nrow(row) != 1) stop("Parameter not in the DSA range table: ", par)
  sprintf("%s–%s", fmt(row$min), fmt(row$max))
}
# Linked parameter moved with a DSA bound (issue #190: u_p with u_np).
dsa_linked <- function(par, fmt) {
  row <- dsa_ranges[dsa_ranges$pars == par, ]
  if (nrow(row) != 1 || is.na(row$linked_par)) stop("No linked parameter: ", par)
  sprintf("%s %s–%s", row$linked_par, fmt(row$linked_min), fmt(row$linked_max))
}
fmt_prob <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)
fmt_util <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
fmt_cost <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",")
fmt_pct  <- function(x) sprintf("%g%%", 100 * x)
fmt_yr   <- function(x) sprintf("%g", x)

# Every economic prevalence uses the same complete-case target population.
n_crp <- n_tmb <- nrow(l_params_base$prediction_population)
k_crp <- sum(l_params_base$prediction_population$crp == 1)
k_tmb <- sum(l_params_base$prediction_population$tmb_braf == 1)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(k_crp / n_crp, l_params_base$p_crp)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(k_tmb / n_tmb, l_params_base$p_tmb_braf)))

prev_ci_note <- function(k, n) {
  ci <- binom.test(k, n)$conf.int
  sprintf("%d/%d; 95%% CI %.1f–%.1f%%", k, n, ci[1] * 100, ci[2] * 100)
}

# Utility source follows the UTILITY_SOURCE switch.
utility_meta <- if (UTILITY_SOURCE == 1) {
  list(source = "CORRECT trial (Gourzoulidis et al. 2018)",
       note = "EQ-5D in regorafenib-treated mCRC (Grothey et al. 2013)")
} else {
  list(source = "METIMMOX EQ-5D-5L (IPD, trial_eq5d_utility_uncertainty())",
       note = paste(c(dk = "Danish", uk = "UK")[[EQ5D_VALUE_SET]],
                    "EQ-5D-5L value set; PSA spread from patient-clustered bootstrap SEs"))
}

# PSA distribution family per parameter from the shared specification. Unit
# prices are fixed in the PSA and varied deterministically (issue #154), so
# their entry is "Fixed" and the range column is the one-way DSA range.
psa_dist <- function(par) {
  spec <- parameter_config$spec
  row <- spec[spec$parameter == par, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) != 1 || !row$psa || is.na(row$distribution)) return("Fixed")
  if (identical(row$distribution, "derived")) {
    if (par %in% c("p_crp", "p_tmb_braf")) return("Joint Dirichlet (derived marginal)")
    return("Derived (u_np - decrement)")
  }
  tools::toTitleCase(row$distribution)
}

scenario_range <- function(name, fmt) {
  sc <- scenarios[[name]]
  sprintf("%s–%s", fmt(sc$min), fmt(sc$max))
}

table_1 <- data.frame(
  Category = c(
    rep("Biomarker prevalences", 2),
    rep("Health-state utilities", 2),
    rep("Treatment costs (€)", 4),
    rep("Other costs (€)", 2),
    rep("Structural parameters", 4)
  ),
  Parameter = c(
    "CRP-positive (week 4, < 5 mg/L)",
    "TMB/BRAF-positive",
    "Progression-free",
    "Post-progression",
    "Nivolumab per administration",
    "FLOX per cycle",
    "CRP testing",
    "NGS testing",
    "CT scan (monitoring)",
    "End-of-life",
    "Discount rate (costs and QALYs)",
    "Time horizon",
    "Post-progression treatment cost (per quarter)",
    "Second treatment sequence (weeks 24–38)"
  ),
  Base_case = c(
    fmt_prob(l_params_base$p_crp),
    fmt_prob(l_params_base$p_tmb_braf),
    fmt_util(l_params_base$u_np),
    fmt_util(l_params_base$u_p),
    sprintf("€%s", fmt_cost(l_params_base$c_drug_nivo)),
    sprintf("€%s", fmt_cost(l_params_base$c_drug_FLOX)),
    sprintf("€%s", fmt_cost(l_params_base$c_test_CRP)),
    sprintf("€%s", fmt_cost(l_params_base$c_test_NGS)),
    sprintf("€%s", fmt_cost(l_params_base$c_test_CT)),
    sprintf("€%s", fmt_cost(l_params_base$c_other_last)),
    fmt_pct(dr),
    sprintf("%g years", time_horizon / 52),
    sprintf("€%s", fmt_cost(l_params_base$c_other_pp)),
    "Given to all progression-free patients"
  ),
  Range = c(
    dsa_range("p_crp", fmt_prob),
    dsa_range("p_tmb_braf", fmt_prob),
    dsa_range("u_np", fmt_util),
    dsa_range("u_p", fmt_util),
    dsa_range("c_drug_nivo", fmt_cost),
    dsa_range("c_drug_FLOX", fmt_cost),
    dsa_range("c_test_CRP", fmt_cost),
    dsa_range("c_test_NGS", fmt_cost),
    dsa_range("c_test_CT", fmt_cost),
    dsa_range("c_other_last", fmt_cost),
    scenario_range("Discount_rate", fmt_pct),
    paste(scenario_range("Time_horizon", fmt_yr), "years"),
    scenario_range("Post_progression_cost", function(x) sprintf("€%s", fmt_cost(x))),
    "Given–omitted"
  ),
  Range_type = c(
    rep("One-way DSA (±20%)", 10),
    rep("Structural scenario", 4)
  ),
  Distribution = c(
    psa_dist("p_crp"), psa_dist("p_tmb_braf"),
    psa_dist("u_np"), psa_dist("u_p"),
    psa_dist("c_drug_nivo"), psa_dist("c_drug_FLOX"),
    psa_dist("c_test_CRP"), psa_dist("c_test_NGS"),
    psa_dist("c_test_CT"), psa_dist("c_other_last"),
    "Fixed", "Fixed", "Fixed", "Fixed"
  ),
  Source = c(
    "METIMMOX", "METIMMOX",
    utility_meta$source, utility_meta$source,
    "Assumption", "NoMA", "Local", "Local",
    "Ref 27", "Ref 28",
    "NoMA guidelines", "Assumption", "Assumption", "METIMMOX protocol"
  ),
  Notes = c(
    prev_ci_note(k_crp, n_crp),
    prev_ci_note(k_tmb, n_tmb),
    paste0(utility_meta$note, "; DSA moves u_p with u_np (",
           dsa_linked("u_np", fmt_util), ")"),
    paste(utility_meta$note,
          "- sampled as u_np minus a non-negative decrement; DSA capped at u_np"),
    paste("Assumption: 40% discount off list price; Norwegian hospital",
          "(LIS tender) prices are confidential and cannot be cited"),
    "",
    "CRP strategy only",
    "TMB/BRAF strategy only",
    "Every 12 weeks",
    "",
    "Varied in deterministic scenarios only",
    "Varied in deterministic scenarios only",
    "Zero in the base case; second-line therapy is outside the modeled scope",
    "Base case gives it to every progression-free patient at weeks 24-38"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(table_1 %>% select(-Category),
      caption = "Table 1: Model input parameters",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Parameter", "Base case", "Range", "Range type",
                    "PSA distribution", "Source", "Notes"),
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "l", "l", "l", "l")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 11) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(table_1$Category)[unique(table_1$Category)]) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "NoMA = Norwegian Medicines Agency. NGS = next-generation sequencing. Costs in 2023 euros.",
      sprintf("One-way DSA ranges are the base value +/- %.0f%% bounds run by 09_DSA.R (prevalences and utilities capped at 1, costs and prevalences at 0).", 100 * DSA_mult),
      "Discount rate and time horizon are not sampled in the PSA; the ranges are the deterministic structural scenarios run by 09_DSA.R and reported in the OWSA report.",
      "Prevalence notes use the common complete-case economic population and exact binomial 95% CIs. Joint biomarker cell probabilities are sampled together from a Dirichlet distribution with the observed cell counts; the marginal prevalences are derived. DSA bounds change one marginal by +/-20%, retaining the other marginal and joint odds ratio. Every population change reweights control and both guided strategies alike.",
      sprintf("Utilities follow the UTILITY_SOURCE switch (currently %s).", if (UTILITY_SOURCE == 1) "1 = CORRECT trial" else "0 = METIMMOX IPD"),
      "PSA distribution: family used for the probabilistic analysis (parameter_distributions.R). 'Fixed' parameters are not sampled in the PSA; drug and test unit costs are published tariffs or assumed list prices, so they are varied deterministically only and carry no value-of-information (issue #154).",
      "The post-progression utility is not sampled independently: the PSA draws a non-negative decrement and sets u_p = u_np - decrement, so no draw places the progressed utility above the progression-free utility. In the one-way DSA, varying u_np holds the decrement fixed (u_p moves with it) and the u_p upper bound is capped at u_np, so no DSA run has utility rising on progression either (issue #190).",
      "The base case applies no post-progression treatment cost and gives every progression-free patient a second treatment sequence at weeks 24-38; both assumptions are tested as structural scenarios in the OWSA report."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```
